schemes.title: Ration Card — Mahafood RCMS
schemes.department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: The ration card is applied for online on RCMS, the transactional site of the Food and Civil Supplies Department. The same login adds or removes a family member, transfers a card to a new taluka, corrects a name and downloads the e-ration card. The card also works as proof of address and of family composition for school admissions, pensions and many other applications.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg of free foodgrain per person per month under NFSA; 35 kg per card for Antyodaya families
eligibility: Ordinarily resident in Maharashtra and not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
One card for one family; the eldest woman of the household aged 18 or above is entered as head of the family
Priority Household (yellow or saffron) under NFSA: annual family income up to Rs 44,000 in a rural area and up to Rs 59,000 in an urban area
Antyodaya (yellow): the poorest families picked by the tehsil — landless labourers, widows, the aged and households with no assured income
A family above the NFSA income limit still gets a white card, which is valid as identity and address proof but carries no subsidised grain
Aadhaar of every member must be seeded and e-KYC done at the fair price shop before grain is released
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member
Proof of residence — electricity bill, property tax receipt, registered rent agreement or a Gram Panchayat letter
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family
Income certificate or salary slip, for the NFSA income test
Gas connection number and the name of the gas agency
Surrender or removal certificate from the earlier taluka, if the family has moved
Bank passbook first page, where the tehsil asks for it

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, delete a member, transfer the card to another taluka, or correct a detail. Pick one — each opens its own form.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives now. The card is issued by that tehsil and the grain comes from a shop in that area.

demoFields.label: Name of Head of Family
demoFields.hint: Spelt exactly as on her Aadhaar. The card is issued in this name and the shop machine checks her fingerprint against it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of Head of Family
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on her own Aadhaar card. A mistake here stops the card at verification.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The OTP for registration, the application number and the approval message all come here. Use a number in the family.

demoFields.label: Full residential address with pin code
demoFields.value: House 148, Gavthan Road, Shivade, Taluka Sinnar, District Nashik — 422103
demoFields.hint: Write it as it appears on the residence proof you are uploading, not a shortened version.

demoFields.label: Family members — name, relation, age, Aadhaar
demoFields.value: Prakash Ramchandra Gaikwad, husband, 41, 9999 4721 7745; Aarti Prakash Gaikwad, daughter, 14, 9999 4721 8836; Ramchandra Nivrutti Gaikwad, father-in-law, 68, 9999 4721 9927
demoFields.hint: Every person who eats in the house. Leave one out and that person gets no grain until a separate add-member application goes through.

demoFields.label: Annual income of the whole family
demoFields.hint: Add up what everyone earns in a year. This decides the colour of the card, so state it correctly and keep the proof.

demoFields.label: Gas connection number and agency
demoFields.hint: Maharashtra asks for this to stop one family holding two cards. Write 'none' if the family has no connection.

demoFields.label: Removal / surrender certificate of the earlier card
demoFields.value: Not applicable — no earlier card held
demoFields.hint: If the family moved from another taluka or state, get this from the old tehsil first. Without it the new card is rejected.

demoSteps: Open rcms.mahafood.gov.in, use 'New User' to register with your mobile number and an OTP, and set a username and password.
Choose 'Apply for New Ration Card', fill the family details and upload Aadhaar, the residence proof, the income proof and the photograph.
Submit and write down the application number. Every enquiry after this is against that number.
The tehsil verifies the papers and a Food Inspector or Talathi may visit the house to confirm the family lives there.
On approval the card is issued and the e-ration card can be downloaded and printed from the same login. Maharashtra is moving to the e-card and away from the printed book.
Take the head of the family to the fair price shop for Aadhaar e-KYC on the ePoS machine. Grain is not released until this is done.
Draw the monthly quota with a fingerprint at the shop. Under One Nation One Ration Card the same card also works at a shop in another district or state.

schemes.title: Mahabhulekh — 7/12, 8A and Property Card
schemes.department: Revenue Department — Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: Mahabhulekh carries the land record of every village in Maharashtra — all districts, 716 talukas and more than 89,000 villages. The 7/12, called the satbara, shows who holds a piece of agricultural land, how much, what is sown on it and any bank charge against it; the 8A lists every holding of one khatedar in the village; the property card does the same for surveyed urban land. Viewing is free, and a digitally signed copy that banks and offices accept costs about Rs 15.
schemes.benefit: Free 7/12, 8A and property card view; digitally signed extract for about Rs 15
eligibility: Land situated in Maharashtra and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view a 7/12, an 8A or a property card — no login, no fee and no proof of ownership is needed
A digitally signed extract needs registration with a mobile number and payment of about Rs 15 per copy
7/12 and 8A cover agricultural land; a property card covers surveyed urban land holding a City Survey number
Only the khatedar or a legal heir can ask the Talathi to correct an entry or to record a mutation
documents: Survey number or gat number of the land, or the khatedar's name
The village, taluka, district and the revenue division they fall in
Mobile number, for a digitally signed copy
Aadhaar card, if you are getting the extract at an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or a CSC
Registered sale deed, for a mutation after a purchase
Death certificate and the heirship paper, for a mutation after a death
The existing 7/12 or 8A extract, where you are asking for a correction

demoFields.label: Revenue division (Vibhag)
demoFields.hint: The six divisions are Amravati, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Konkan, Nagpur, Nashik and Pune. Satara falls under Pune division.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: 7/12 for one piece of agricultural land, 8A to see every holding of one khatedar in the village, property card for urban land.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is kept village by village, so a wrong village shows nothing.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Search by survey or gat number if you know it, otherwise by the khatedar's surname. The number is the surer way.

demoFields.label: Survey Number / Gat Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the old extract or the purchase deed. A wrong sub-division number pulls up a neighbour's land.

demoFields.label: Khatedar's name — surname, first name, middle name
demoFields.hint: Only if you are searching by name. Use the spelling on the land record, which may not match Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Verification code shown on the screen
demoFields.hint: Type the characters exactly as displayed. It refreshes if you get it wrong.

demoFields.label: Mobile number, for a digitally signed copy
demoFields.hint: Needed only for the paid signed extract. The download link comes to this number against an OTP.

demoFields.label: Payment for the digitally signed extract
demoFields.hint: Pay for each copy you need. Buy one for each bank or office that will keep a copy.

demoSteps: Open bhulekh.mahabhumi.gov.in, choose your division, then the district, taluka and village.
Search by the gat or survey number and open the 7/12. Check the area, the khatedar names, the crop entry and the 'other rights' column, which is where a bank charge or a loan is recorded.
Pull the 8A as well to see every piece of land held in that village under the same khata. That is what land revenue is charged on.

The free print is for your own reference. For a bank, a court, a subsidy claim or a sale, buy the digitally signed extract from digitalsatbara.mahabhumi.gov.in for about Rs 15 — offices do not accept the unsigned print.
Read the ferfar (mutation) entries. After a purchase or a death the change shows here only once the Talathi has recorded it and the Tahsildar has passed the order.
If a name, an area or a crop entry is wrong, apply to the village Talathi with the deed or the heirship paper. Fixing it now is far easier than at the time of a sale.
If you cannot use the site, the same extracts are issued at an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or a CSC for a small fee.
schemes.helpline: Your village Talathi or the taluka Tahsildar's office; extracts are also issued at Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras and CSCs

schemes.title: MPSC Recruitment — Rajyaseva, Group B and Group C
schemes.brief: The Maharashtra Public Service Commission recruits for the Maharashtra Civil Services (Rajyaseva) and for the Group B and Group C combined services, which include PSI, STI and Assistant Section Officer, as well as the engineering, agriculture, forest and judicial services. Notifications and syllabi are published on mpsc.gov.in; the application itself is filed on the separate online system. You build one candidate profile, lock it, and then apply to each advertisement from it.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every MPSC examination and direct recruitment, with hall tickets and results
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Maharashtra domicile certificate is needed for the reserved category posts and for most state services
Age as the advertisement states — generally 19 to 38 years for the open category, relaxed to 43 for backward class candidates, with further relaxation for ex-servicemen and disabled candidates
A degree from a recognised university, complete on the closing date the advertisement gives, for Rajyaseva and the Group B posts
Knowledge of Marathi is required, and it is tested in the examination
A Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid on the closing date, for OBC, VJNT and SBC candidates
Each advertisement sets its own age, qualification and physical standards — read that one before you pay the fee
documents: Aadhaar card
SSC (Class 10) certificate, which governs the date of birth and the spelling of the name
Degree certificate and every marksheet
Maharashtra domicile certificate
Caste certificate and Caste Validity Certificate, for a reserved category
Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid on the closing date, for OBC, VJNT and SBC
Disability, ex-serviceman, sportsperson or project-affected certificate, where that reservation is claimed
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature in the sizes the portal states

demoFields.label: Examination or post applied for
demoFields.value: Maharashtra Group B (Combined) — PSI, STI and ASO
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Check the age limit and the qualification in that advertisement before you pay anything.

demoFields.label: Candidate's full name as on the SSC certificate
demoFields.hint: The SSC certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Every later check is made against it.

demoFields.label: Father's name and Mother's name
demoFields.value: Bhaskar Namdev Deshmukh / Shobha Bhaskar Deshmukh
demoFields.hint: As on the SSC certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSC certificate. The age limit counts from this date and it cannot be changed once the profile is locked.

demoFields.label: Category, caste and caste certificate number
demoFields.hint: Claim only the category you hold a Maharashtra certificate for. The number is printed on the certificate itself.

demoFields.label: Non-Creamy Layer certificate number and validity
demoFields.hint: It must be valid on the closing date of the advertisement, not merely on the day you apply. An expired one loses you the reservation.

demoFields.label: Maharashtra domicile
demoFields.hint: Needed for the reserved seats and for most state posts. Get it from the tehsil or through Aaple Sarkar if you do not have it.

demoFields.label: Educational qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected. Enter the marks as printed on the final marksheet.

demoFields.label: Knowledge of Marathi
demoFields.value: Yes — studied Marathi up to SSC
demoFields.hint: MPSC requires it and tests it. Declare it honestly and keep the school certificate for verification.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give the choices the form allows. The Commission allots the nearest centre it can, but it is not guaranteed.

demoSteps: Watch mpsc.gov.in for the advertisement and read the age, qualification, physical standards and reservation conditions before doing anything else.
Create your candidate profile on mpsconline.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the SSC certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the stated sizes.
Lock the profile. Check every entry twice first — the locked profile is what is carried into all your applications and it is not freely editable afterwards.
Run the eligibility check for that advertisement, submit the application and pay the fee online. Save the application number and the payment receipt.
Download the hall ticket about a week before each stage and take it with a photo identity card.
Rajyaseva runs as a preliminary, a main examination and an interview; the combined Group B and Group C examinations run as a preliminary and a main. Each result is published on the Commission's site.

Document verification comes last. Produce the originals of everything you claimed, including the Caste Validity Certificate within the time the Commission allows — a claim you cannot prove there costs you the post.
schemes.helpline: Maharashtra Public Service Commission — contact details and every notice are published on mpsc.gov.in

schemes.title: Mahavitaran — New Electricity Connection and Consumer Services
schemes.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran)
schemes.brief: Mahavitaran, the state electricity distribution company, supplies the whole of Maharashtra except most of Mumbai city and its suburbs. A new domestic, commercial or agricultural connection is applied for on its Web Self Service portal, which also handles bill payment, self meter readings, a name or address change on the account, a load change, reconnection after disconnection, security deposit refund and complaints. The information site is mahadiscom.in; the applications and account transactions happen on the self-service portal.
schemes.benefit: New connection normally released within one month of a complete application, plus online billing, meter readings and complaints
eligibility: Premises anywhere in the MSEDCL supply area — the whole of Maharashtra except most of Mumbai city and its suburbs
You own the premises or lawfully occupy them, and can produce proof of that
No unpaid electricity dues standing against the premises or against you at another connection
The internal wiring is finished and tested, with a test report signed by a licensed electrical contractor
Under the Electricity Act, supply must be given within one month of a complete application wherever the line and the network already reach the premises
documents: Proof of ownership or occupancy — 7/12 extract, property tax receipt, sale deed, Index II or a registered rent agreement
Photo identity proof and Aadhaar card
Recent passport-size photograph
Test report of the internal wiring from a licensed electrical contractor
Consumer number and the latest paid bill of a neighbouring or existing connection, to identify the feeder
No Objection Certificate from the owner, if you are a tenant
Municipal or Gram Panchayat building permission, where the sub-division asks for it

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New connection, bill payment, name or address change, load change, reconnection, security deposit refund or a complaint. A new connection can be started without registering.

demoFields.label: Tariff category and phase
demoFields.hint: Residential for a home, commercial for a shop, agricultural for a pump. The wrong category means the wrong rate on every bill afterwards.

demoFields.label: Connected load applied for
demoFields.hint: Add up the wattage of the lights, fans, pump and appliances you will run. Asking for too little means paying again later for a load change.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name as it should appear on the bill
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on Aadhaar and matching the ownership or rent paper. Changing it later is a separate name-change application.

demoFields.label: Full address of the premises where supply is wanted
demoFields.value: Plot 27, Shivneri Nagar, Hudkeshwar Road, Nagpur — 440034
demoFields.hint: The address of the building itself, not a correspondence address. The section engineer comes to this spot.

demoFields.label: Nearest existing consumer number
demoFields.hint: The 12-digit number from a neighbour's or the landlord's bill. It tells the office which pole and feeder you will be connected to.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number and mobile number
demoFields.hint: The request number, the site inspection message and the demand note all come to this mobile.

demoFields.label: Proof of ownership or occupancy uploaded
demoFields.value: Property tax receipt, Nagpur Municipal Corporation, 2026-27
demoFields.hint: Any one of the accepted papers. A tenant uploads the registered rent agreement and the owner's NOC.

demoFields.label: Licensed contractor's test report
demoFields.hint: Get the wiring tested before you apply. No supply is released without this report.

demoFields.label: Payment of processing fee and security deposit
demoFields.value: Paid online against demand note DN-NGP-2026-55214
demoFields.hint: The exact amount is in the demand note the office raises after inspection. Pay it online and keep the receipt.

demoSteps: Open wss.mahadiscom.in, choose the new connection request and fill the premises details, the tariff category and the load. You can start this without registering.
Upload the ownership or rent proof, the identity proof, the photograph and the contractor's test report, then submit and note the request number.
The section engineer inspects the site and the office raises a demand note — the firm quotation for the service line, the processing fee and the security deposit.

Pay the demand note online through the portal. The meter is installed and supply is released after payment; where the line already reaches the premises this should happen within one month of the complete application.
Register on the self-service portal with your new 12-digit consumer number so you can see and pay bills, send self meter readings and switch to Go Green paperless billing.

If the connection or a repair is delayed beyond the time the rules allow, file a Standards of Performance compensation claim, and use the complaint and Swagat Cell pages on the same portal to track it.
Keep the consumer number written down somewhere safe. Every later service — name change, load change, reconnection, deposit refund — is asked for against that number.
schemes.helpline: Your MSEDCL sub-division office, or the Swagat Cell complaint pages on the Mahavitaran self-service portal
